**HOLD for G7.** The numerical comparison is supported in the bounded T4 K0/K1 cell, but I reproduced a failed-attempt reporting defect and found two missing predeclared negative controls. I made no edits and ran no full suite or live fit.

### Findings

1. **Major, O6: rejected scores remain visible as valid-looking scores.** [fa_rank_selection.jl](/Users/z3437171/.codex/worktrees/b9ae/HSquared.jl/src/fa_rank_selection.jl:288) assigns `loglik` and `criterion` from the optimizer’s reported objective before the independent check. An injected objective offset made every attempt fail that check, yet all three failed rows retained finite likelihoods and criteria. Those rows also fed `objective_range` and `start_sensitive` ([lines 315 and 525](/Users/z3437171/.codex/worktrees/b9ae/HSquared.jl/src/fa_rank_selection.jl:315)). The probe returned `selection_status=:unavailable`, `start_sensitive=true`, and an FA objective range of `1.18345` with no eligible FA start. This conflicts with the [contract](/Users/z3437171/.codex/worktrees/b9ae/HSquared.jl/docs/design/auto-fa-rank-contract.md:86) and [usage text](/Users/z3437171/.codex/worktrees/b9ae/HSquared.jl/docs/design/auto-fa-rank-experimental-usage.md:50) saying failed values are missing. Keep rejected optimizer output in a clearly named diagnostic field, and derive criterion and sensitivity from verified values; add a regression test through R serialization.

2. **Moderate, O1/O3: required negative controls are absent from the retained acceptance test.** The [validation plan](/Users/z3437171/.codex/worktrees/b9ae/HSquared.jl/docs/design/auto-fa-rank-validation-plan.md:21) requires an unmatched-floor control and altered normalization *or fixed-design* controls. The [acceptance entry point](/Users/z3437171/.codex/worktrees/b9ae/HSquared.jl/test/auto_fa_rank_acceptance.jl:1) runs only [test_auto_fa_rank.jl](/Users/z3437171/.codex/worktrees/b9ae/HSquared.jl/test/test_auto_fa_rank.jl:92); its floor and dense-objective checks do not contain those deliberate controls. My injected offset confirms that an altered objective is rejected, but it is not a retained test, and I did not verify an altered fixed design. Add the controls before claiming O1–O10 complete.

Source and focused tests support record-major ordering, the common REML context, nominal counts `q=14/18`, the signed score and tie rule, projected-kernel refusals, bounded retries, and interruption ledgers. A separate no-optimization probe gave zero K0-versus-zero-loading-FA nesting discrepancy; the retry had nonzero loadings and identical genetic diagonal. The R source and retained mandatory-live receipt support selected-K0 transport and plain-R partial-ledger transport. The controlled K1 transport witness does **not** establish ordinary selected-K1 selection or rank reliability.
